from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess
root=Path('/opt/telegram-robot-leads')
private=Path('/root/project-secrets/telegram-robot-leads')
state=Path('/var/lib/telegram-robot-leads/operation-state.json')
print('ROOT_EXISTS',root.is_dir())
verified=root/'.verified-source-commit'
print('INSTALLED_SHA',verified.read_text().strip())
print('SESSION_COUNT',len(list(private.glob('*.session'))))
print('STATE_PRESENT',state.is_file())
if state.is_file():
    d=json.loads(state.read_text())
    print('RECORDED_ADDITIONS',[(k,d.get('accounts',{}).get(k,{}).get('member_adds')) for k in ('1','2')])
    print('PENDING_MEMBERS',len(d.get('pending_member_actions',{})))
    print('RECORDED_MEMBER_IDS',len(d.get('approved_user_ids_done',{})))
r=subprocess.run(['pm2','jlist'],env={'PM2_HOME':'/root/.pm2','PATH':'/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin'},capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=18)
print('PM2_CALL_OK',r.returncode==0)
if r.returncode==0:
    rows=json.loads(r.stdout)
    workers=[x for x in rows if x.get('name')=='telegram-robot-leads']
    print('TELEGRAM_WORKERS',len(workers))
    if len(workers)==1:
        print('TELEGRAM_STATUS',workers[0].get('pm2_env',{}).get('status'))
print('READ_ONLY_PREFLIGHT_COMPLETE')
